executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $241.96 per resident day (48.4% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.

Cost year 2025: the home recorded $3,282,841 in Connecticut Medicaid revenue (after its Medicaid contractual allowance) for 8,692 Medicaid days, $377.69 per Medicaid day. DSS's Medicaid daily rate was $362.38 for July 2024 to June 2025 and $369.91 for July 2025 to June 2026.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 0.1% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $16,126, 0.7% of the $2,184,135 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $448,830, $49.72 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $243,700 (54.3%), allocated fringe $44,559 (9.9%), non-wage costs $160,571 (35.8%). Raw food was $146,120 ($16.19 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61).
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $125,780, $13.93 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $125,780 (100.0%).
Missing data: cost year 2016 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

findings.statement: Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 13 line(s) of the report, a net reduction of $234,196 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Other Administrative Salaries (page 10 line A4), removed $115,808; Aides And Attendants (page 10 line A12d), removed $99,887; Food Service Supervisor (page 10 line A5b), removed $8,617. Separately, the home itself removed $411,214 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

Every year's full detail, including years left out here and the reason, is in https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075272/financials.json.
Built only from public datasets published on danbeem.xyz. Absence of a record means it is not in these datasets, not that it did not happen.
Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2016 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
